nodes.label: Daya Ram Sahni
nodes.subject: history
nodes.detail: Indian archaeologist who began systematic excavation of Harappa in 1921 — the first professional recognition of the site's significance. His work, along with R.D. Banerjee's at Mohenjo-daro, enabled John Marshall's 1924 announcement of the Indus Valley Civilisation.
nodes.chapter_title: Harappan Culture: Bronze Age Urbanization in the Indus Valley

nodes.label: R.D. Banerjee
nodes.subject: history
nodes.detail: Indian historian-archaeologist who excavated Mohenjo-daro in the early 1920s, recognising its antiquity alongside Harappa. His work paved the way for the announcement of the Harappan/Indus Valley Civilisation in 1924.
